320.title: Build Symphony-inspired autonomous loop foundation
320.body:
## Summary

A controller crash after durable attempt TERMINAL but before the campaign result checkpoint used to leave completed work unreconciled. This PR now restores that evidence without redispatch, checkpoints the repaired campaign, and continues to the next independent task. Started-unresolved attempts are isolated; explicitly fenced unstarted intents are retired before a new attempt identity is used.

It preserves the strict one-turn proof separately from the autonomous North Star. The autonomous policy/kernel/store/STATIC controller support multiple tasks, corrective work, typed UNKNOWN, stale-target replanning and session-independent restore. A 30-round campaign across five fresh controllers is statically tested.

Design authority:

- `docs/AUTONOMOUS_DEVELOPMENT_LOOP_NORTH_STAR.md`
- `docs/SYMPHONY_AUTONOMOUS_LOOP_DESIGN.md`
- `docs/SYMPHONY_AUTONOMOUS_LOOP_HANDOVER.md`
- `docs/SYMPHONY_INSPIRED_MINIMAL_ORCHESTRATOR.md` documents the current strict
  proof implementation and explicitly defers final product behavior to the
  North Star.

## North Star

The shared North Star is aligned with Draft PR #325. The Symphony-specific design explicitly allows a minimally modified upstream-Symphony track and a hardened New Chinponey track to coexist.

The finished loop is not one command / one turn / one model start.

Target behavior is unattended multi-round development:

```text
wake/poll
-> durable restore
-> next task
-> agent work
-> verify
-> repair/corrective/recovery when safe
-> durable checkpoint
-> next task
-> continue until completion / true human boundary / confirmed quota exhaustion /
   configured campaign limit
```

**Safety protects continuation. Safety is not the goal of stopping.**

Important design changes:

- blind resend of an ambiguous external write remains forbidden;
- read/test/evidence/network recovery may use bounded retry;
- failed work may create a new corrective task;
- UNKNOWN is classified instead of globally meaning STOP;
- stale target HEAD should trigger readback/replan when safe, not automatic
  campaign death;
- a blocked subtask should be isolated while independent safe work continues;
- proof limits such as one turn/one start are profile/config restrictions that
  must be openable later;
- architecture should remain capable of approaching upstream Symphony behavior;
- a separate minimally modified upstream-Symphony track may coexist with the
  hardened New Chinponey track.

## Subscription-only policy target

Unattended operation is intended to use already-paid ChatGPT/Codex subscription
capacity only.

- no automatic metered API fallback;
- no automatic paid-credit/overage purchase or enablement;
- no automatic paid-provider fallback;
- confirmed quota exhaustion may stop new model work;
- inability to read a remaining allowance value alone is not proof of quota
  exhaustion.

No billing/API-key/permission/secret changes are authorized by this PR.

## Existing implementation / LIVE evidence

The current implementation contains the bounded Codex app-server adapter,
GitHub durable transport and isolated Symphony LIVE command/claim/result schema.

A prior real proof attempt consumed exactly one command/model start. Codex
created the requested proof content but did not create the required commit/push.
A terminal UNKNOWN was durably recorded and the second poll was NO-OP with no
redispatch. That command is consumed and must not be replayed.

This is useful component evidence, **not closed-loop PASS** and not the final
autonomous architecture.

## Current validation / Official Symphony Local LIVE

Current pushed PR HEAD: `2f6d2dcc1d9761797a19aad10263a5025ae8300b`. Fresh main readback: `702497c6b464a3b1ab09441b21fc6f96bd3bb2d0`; ahead 34 / behind 78 at this readback. Main advanced after the proof interval; it was not merged or rebased into this branch.

Issue [#336](https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/issues/336) exists and remains OPEN with the proof label. Proof branch `codex/symphony-minimal-live-proof-336` remains at `8ed44bf964d2c74ec7af74c7e26f9992a0b049d7`.

Official Symphony at `be10a1b79df723d6d7612b5651c8522704dafb2e` has now been observed in Local WSL campaigns:

| Generation | Terminal result | Observation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | FAIL, preserved | App Server rejected `reject`; 0 model turns |
| 2 | FAIL, preserved | Granular policy passed; pinned workflow parser produced invalid UTF-8 before `turn/start`; 0 model turns |
| 3 | FAIL, preserved | Two startup response timeouts at the 5-second default; 0 model turns |
| 4 | PASS for the bounded one-file worker proof | One real model turn completed, expected isolated artifact created, normal same-thread continuation observed; second turn interrupted by operator stop |

Generation 4 used a separate empty workspace root, the explicit granular policy, ASCII template and `codex.read_timeout_ms: 60000`. Codex ChatGPT login was confirmed. The captured App Server child had none of the five paid/API selector names or four tracker token names. Only the allowed new proof artifact changed; existing edits/deletions and observed unauthorized Git mutations were zero. Immediately after LIVE stop, main/PR/proof refs were unchanged from their starting values. The process and port were confirmed stopped. Artifact adoption remains held in the proof workspace.

Validation for the current pushed HEAD:

- full command-bus suite: 1,908 tests, successful, 1 inherited skip; focused Symphony tests: 149 successful;
- pinned upstream policy/config and real Issue rendered UTF-8/JSON checks passed before generation 4;
- [Symphony CI 37874526988](https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/actions/runs/37874526988): SUCCESS;
- [Blue CI 37874526987](https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/actions/runs/37874526987): SUCCESS.

Generation 4 result record, sanitized log, child observation, runbook/design updates and the STATIC proof-HEAD clarification are now committed and pushed in `2b6b0582c68532f0dd2cec6328306a111ab6b593`. All seven files were checked byte-exact against the preserved rescue archive and remote Git blobs. Local regression/compileall and exact-head Symphony/Blue CI passed. The isolated worker artifact remains held in its proof workspace and was not adopted into this PR or main. The STATIC clarification was not re-LIVE tested. No additional LIVE was executed.

Final [G4 delivery checkpoint](https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/pull/320#issuecomment-6072554378) includes parent/current HEAD, all seven file digests, the eight-file rescue archive digest, CI run/artifact IDs and verified downloaded artifact digests. The missing execution-helper blocker was overcome through app-reviewed WSL execution without installing helpers or changing settings/permissions. G4 final preservation has no remaining blocker.

Next active objective: one separately authorized G5 Local LIVE proof of the signed worker observation hook and durable ledger restart. Automatic Git adoption, real G5 delivery, completed continuation, natural stall recovery and quota-reset/autonomous restart recovery remain unproven.

## G5 Cloud STATIC production observation bridge

At exact HEAD `2f6d2dcc1d9761797a19aad10263a5025ae8300b`, the pinned Official Symphony worker hook patch, signed local JSONL observer, create-only durable attempt ingestion, restart/duplicate/conflict fixtures, G5 proof workflow and prepared Issue are committed. The upstream patch only observes STARTED/TERMINAL at the worker lifetime boundary; it does not change Symphony polling, scheduling, turns, continuation, retry/backoff, stall recovery or concurrency. G5 worker terminal is recorded as UNKNOWN/RECOVERABLE_UNKNOWN until separate result inspection; Git auto-adoption remains disconnected.

- [G5 bridge and next LIVE plan](docs/SYMPHONY_G5_PRODUCTION_OBSERVATION_BRIDGE.md); [prepared Issue](docs/SYMPHONY_G5_LIVE_PROOF_ISSUE.md); [G5 proof workflow](docs/SYMPHONY_G5_LIVE_PROOF_WORKFLOW.md).
- Machine-readable [STATIC evidence](automation/command_bus/evidence/symphony-g5-production-observation-static.json), SHA-256 `e6be92ac802690f6f946490364e3a2f1f13f0c70fe00af9cde595a5018960818`.
- Local STATIC: focused 149 PASS; full command-bus 1,908 PASS / 1 skip; compileall, YAML parse, pinned upstream `git apply --check` and diff check PASS.
- Exact-head Symphony CI `37874526988` and Blue CI `37874526987`: SUCCESS. Artifact IDs `11591772769` and `11592216332`, respectively.
- No G5 LIVE/model/provider execution, proof Issue creation, Git result adoption, merge, main write or paid-route change. Real hook delivery/restart and terminal capture remain UNKNOWN until a separately authorized Local LIVE.

## Safety

Still no PR merge, direct default-branch write, force push, destructive history
rewrite, billing/credit/API-key/permission/secret change, or unapproved extra
LIVE model/provider execution.

343.title: Symphony G6.1 STATIC production wiring (updateRefs CAS, pre-close snapshot, readers)
343.body:
G6.1 Production Wiring **STATIC** on top of Draft PR #320 (`8c53c505`). Not for merge into #320 without review; no LIVE.

**Counts:** model/provider LIVE 0 · Symphony worker launches 0 · real Git adoption 0 · GitHub writes by G6.1 code 0 · GraphQL mutations sent 0.

## What it adds
- **Atomic expected-head ref update**: GraphQL `updateRefs` with mandatory `beforeOid`, `force:false`, one ref, one request, no retry. Official schema (read-only introspection) says updates are atomic and `beforeOid` must match. The REST `PATCH git/refs` and `updateRef` have no old-value input and are not used. The reply proves nothing about the new ref value, so the outcome is always settled by a ref GET.
- **Result bytes survive Symphony cleanup**: before the Issue closes, a snapshot outside the workspace stores create-only SHA-256 objects, checks the workspace didn't change during capture, writes a sealed manifest and reads everything back. Official cleanup is unchanged.
- **Authenticated readers** (GET / GraphQL query only): hash-verified target inventory, `read_at(expected_head)` for manifests, and an Issue-based task validity / request-revision contract.
- **Independent verification contract** (syntax / tests / secret_scan), bound to result/source/head/scope digests.
- **Wiring** into the unchanged G6 bridge; `GitHubGitTransport` rejects non-static HTTP (`NOT_WIRED`).

## Evidence
- Read-only real GitHub qualification: 143 requests, 0 writes. 134-file branch matches local Git bytes. The 1,581-entry tree is hash-verified. A real commit rebuilt byte-identical (GitHub strips the trailing newline in its message echo).
- Regression matrix K01–K13 (crash/restart, lost reply, CAS race, stale HEAD, scope, tampering, foreign SHA): never more than one `updateRefs` per adoption, main untouched.
- Tests: G6.1 44 OK, G6 46 OK. The full suite on Windows shows exactly the same failure set as the untouched base commit. Linux CI is authoritative.
- See `docs/SYMPHONY_G61_PRODUCTION_WIRING_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md` and `docs/evidence/symphony-g61-static/`.

## UNKNOWN (stop before LIVE)
Real `updateRefs` error shape/rulesets (rulesets API 403 on this plan) · real `POST git/commits` byte determinism (fails closed on mismatch) · K04 fence-without-call stays UNKNOWN by the G6 rule · real external test/secret-scan attestations.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

364.title: Symphony operator installation: OFF workflows and same-job seam
364.body:
## 問題と変更

本番接続の方針は承認済みだが、mainには#320/#343の依存部品が未導入。本PRは#343をbaseにした最小の**非稼働設置レビュー候補**で、既存coreをコピーしない。

手動issuer/candidate verifierのOFF workflow、独立review内容とdispatch入力を照合する同一jobメモリ接続、immutable candidate全bytesとstage leaseの純粋検証を追加。旧STATIC guard・strict CI provenance・Official Symphonyの継続/retry/backoff/stall機能は無変更。token要求前のcreate-only intentで重複を拒否し、曖昧な結果はGET-onlyへ。

**INSTALLATION_REVIEW_READY / NOT_INSTALLED / LIVE_NO_GO**。workflowはhard OFF・read権限のみ。実review reader/OIDC callback/credential factory/staging runtimeは未設置で、別の具体的activationレビューが必要。本PRをmainへ直接Mergeしない。依存順は#320 → #343 → 本PR → 別途activation/権限レビュー → 別途一回LIVE承認。

## 検証

Local: 新規14件、重点44件、全回帰2214件（skip1）、既存暗号8件PASS。YAML・compile・diff・固定Docker秘密スキャンPASS。LIVE/OIDC/staging/実送信/adoption/権限Secrets課金変更0。

設置契約・正確な未実装条件・最小権限・GitHub公式dispatch/ref制約は `docs/SYMPHONY_OPERATOR_INSTALLATION_REVIEW.md`、依存closure・証拠hashは `docs/evidence/symphony-operator-installation/`。最終HEAD `215d962d838aba913e2dde08ec392bb7fcaef4be` のSymphony CI 38119292584 / installation STATIC CI 38119292677は成功。remote全22差分blobはbytes一致。Blue/独立synthetic CIは本stacked PRでは起動していないためNOT_RUN。

正式仕様: https://github.com/kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0/pull/343#issuecomment-6106213810
